Joining the ongoing summer price drops on AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2 at $100 off, we are also featuring the return of Prime Day all-time low pricing on AirTag 2. But today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by M5 MacBook Pro with the upgraded 24GB of RAM and 96W charger at $320 off alongside all base model Apple Watch Series 11 colors back in-stock at $100 off. From there, we also have a rare chance at savings on the Philips Hue Bridge Pro as well as new all-time lows on Satechi’s 2026 Space Black metal 25W 3-in-1 MagSafe Charging Station at 30% off and the brand’s Mac mini-style Thunderbolt 5 CubeDock at $100 off. Get a closer look below.

  • AirPods Max 2 $449 (Reg. $549)
  • AirPods Pro 3 $200 (Reg. $249)
  • AirPods 4 $99 (Reg. $129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $145 (Reg. $179)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC $119 (Reg. $179 new) – Renewed Premium

Black Friday in July pricing hits latest AirTag 2, score some from $22 a pop

If you’re looking to secure some of Apple’s latest item finders, the new enhanced AirTag 2 that dropped this year is seeing some deals this week for the Black Friday in July festivities. Deals on the new AirTag 2 have been largely been hard to come by outside of the recent Prime Day bonanza but if you missed out then, there’s some cash to be saved this week as well.

Amazon has dropped the single AirTag 2 listing down by a couple bucks now, from $29 to $27, but you can save even more with the 4-pack right now if you can put a small fleet of them to good use.

  • AirTag 2 $27 (Reg. $29)
  • AirTag 2 (4-pack) $89 (Reg. $99)

Clearly the single listing is seeing a very light deal right now, but it has only sold for less than this once – it was $24 for Prime Day about a month ago now.

However, the 4-pack offers a better per AirTag price even when it’s at full MSRP, so the 10% price drop right now actually brings the per Tag price down to just over $22 Prime shipped for the lowest we have tracked since release in new condition. Considering Amazon is charging slightly more than this for a single first-generation AirTag, this is actually a solid opportunity to pick up a small bundle and put them to use this summer.

This somewhat surprising return to the Prime Day low is also accompanied by a series of notable Apple deals this week for Black Friday in July, from AirPods Pro 3 and the 2026 AirPods Max 2 to the official MagSafe battery and more:

Apple’s iPhone Air MagSafe Battery just dropped back to best price ever at 40% off

Just after seeing iPhone Air drop to a new all-time low at nearly $160 off in the now live Black Friday in July sale, Amazon has also now dropped the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery back to its best price ever at a sizable 40% off.

Amazon is now offering the official Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery down at $59 shipped.

  • Apple iPhone Air MagSafe Battery $59 (Reg. $99)

You’re looking at Apple’s regularly $99 portable MagSafe power bank solution here with a solid 40% in savings. We saw an unexpectedly lengthy period of time between early May and late June with it bouncing back and forth from full price to the low we have here today, but we are getting another solid shot at it again right now.

Previous to the May low, it had never dipped below $79 at Amazon.

For those unfamiliar here, this is indeed the official Apple power bank for iPhone Air – it works with other MagSafe gear but its form-factor is custom tailored for the iPhone Air frame.

It’s not the cheapest MagSafe power bank out there, that’s for sure, but it is approaching a much more digestible territory for many folks at 40% off, and I would argue it is among the most elegant options out there – not to mention one of the thinnest that also delivers streamlined iOS widget support, and a precision fit for iPhone Air.

M5 MacBook Pro with upgraded 24GB of RAM and 96W charger now $320 off

Joining some ongoing price drops on the current M5/M5 Pro MacBook lineup at Amazon, we just spotted another standout deal courtesy of B&H that knocks $320 off the base model M5 with 24GB of RAM.

B&H is now offering the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with the upgraded 24GB of RAM and the standard 1TB storage capacity down at $1,899 shipped – only available on the Space Black colorway.

This deal also includes the upgrade 96W Apple charger that will run you an extra $20 if you bought this setup from Apple – you can’t opt for the faster charger at Amazon and most big box retailers.

That leaves the regular price on this configuration at $2,219 shipped and you with $320 in savings scooping it up at B&H.

It is also worth mentioning that, while there are some deals at Amazon right now on the latest MacBook lineup that offer some serious relief from the latest price increases, this same 25GB M5 will run you $2,049 there with the standard 70W charger.

Down below you’ll find a rundown of discounted models at Amazon – just be sure to check out this 48GB 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro while it is $400 off as well:

  • 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro 16GB/1TB $1,849 (Reg. $1,999)
  • 16-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,299 (Reg. $3,599)
  • 16-inch M5 Max MacBook Pro 48GB/1TB $3,999 (Reg. $4,399)

All base model Apple Watch Series 11 colors back in-stock at $100 off

We are catching a series of notable new Apple deals this week, including $100 off AirPods Max 2 and a return all-time low on AirTag 2. Those deals are also joining the ongoing $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3 and now Amazon once again has all colors of the base model Apple Watch Series 11 back in-stock at $100 off.

This is indeed the same deal we featured last week when it went live, but Amazon was having trouble keeping all colors of both the 42mm and 46mm base aluminum models in stock at the discounted rate. As of this morning, all of the case options on both sizes are now at the ready:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (Reg. $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (Reg. $429)

The 42mm and 46mm Series 11 models are marked down to $299 and $329, respectively, in all four case colors: Jet Black, Silver, Rose Gold, and Space Gray.

You’re looking at solid $100 in savings here and among the best prices we have tracked. We did see many of these configs for $20 less during Prime Day last month, but if you missed out there this is otherwise the best price we have tracked since release in September 2025.

A notable chance to land a new Apple wearable for the summer and beyond, it will likely take well into 2026 before we start seeing anything better than this on the new Series 12 models Apple will presumably launch this fall.

Scope out more of this week’s best Apple deals below:

Satechi’s 2026 Mac mini-style Thunderbolt 5 CubeDock hits best price ever at $100 off today

The latest Satechi Thunderbolt 5 CubeDock is one of the nicer looking and more capable docking stations in its price range – especially if you’re a Mac/Mac mini user. And it just dropped to its best Amazon price ever at $100 off.

Just after seeing after seeing the brand’s Space Black metal 25W 3-in-1 MagSafe Charging Station hit its best price ever at 30% off, the official Satechi Amazon storefront is now offering its 2026 Thunderbolt 5 CubeDock down at $299.99 shipped.

Regularly $400, this is $100 off the list price and the best we can find.

Deals have been rare on this machine since launch – it fell to the previous low during Prime Day about a month ago at $320, but has now dropped again to deliver new Amazon all-time low pricing.

Black Friday in July Beats deals: Solo Buds from just $43, up to $98 off Powerbeats Fit, more

Alongside this week’s AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2 deals, we are also catching a series of price drops across the latest Beats lineup. This includes price drops on Powerbeats Pro 2 and the latest Powerbeats Fit, but we also spotted a chance to score the Transparent Red Beats Solo Buds at just $42.99 via Best Buy. Details below.

There are some solid price drops landing on brand new condition units at Amazon this week, all of which are at the best prices since Prime Day:

  • Beats Powerbeats Fit $170 (Reg. $200)
  • Beats Powerbeats Pro 2 $200 (Reg. $250)
  • Beats Solo 4 Wireless On-Ear $130 (Reg. $200)

But we also wanted to highlight some of the “excellent” condition open-box deals over at Best Buy on the more affordable Beats Solo Buds. If you’re just looking for a solid new set of in-ears and don’t need all of the bells and whistles that come along with the far more pricey sets, you can land a current-set of Beats for just over $40 right now:

  • Transparent Red Beats Solo Buds $43 (Reg. $70 new)
  • Matte Black Beats Solo Buds $45 (Reg. $70 new)
  • Gravel Gray Beats Powerbeats Fit $102 (Reg. $200 new)

But if it’s the Apple AirPods you’re after, the Black Friday in July deals have arrived across the lineup at up to $100 off this week:

Amazon now offering $100 off latest AirPods Max 2

Update: Amazon is now offering $100 off all AirPods Max 2 colors.

Joining the ongoing $50 price drop on AirPods Pro 3 and the return all-time low landing today on the latest AirTag 2, Amazon is now offering $100 off the latest AirPods Max 2.

Amazon is now offering Apple’s 2026 AirPods Max 2 headphones at $449 shipped.

Regularly $549, this is a straight up $100 price drop and the best we can find. Now slightly undercutting the Best Buy deal, this is the second-best discount we have tracked on Apple’s latest over-ears since release earlier this year.

We see some fleeting deals on Max 2 at $150 off during the Prime Day festivities, with select colors coming in and out of stock during the 4-day event. But you’re, otherwise, looking at the lowest price we have tracked at Amazon here. Both previous to, and after, these sale events we had never seen AirPods Max drop below $497 or so.

While the Max 2 look very much the same as the now previous-gen AirPods Max (USB-C), Apple has made some marked enhancements here by way of the H2 chip – new amp for “elevated sound quality,” up to “1.5x more Active Noise Cancellation,” a Camera remote control, and you only have to say “Siri” instead of “Hey Siri.”

iPhone Air hits all-time lows for Black Friday in July at $159 off

Alongside the ongoing summer deal on AirPods Pro 3, this week is ushering in some new Apple deals with return all-time lows on AirTag 2 and a $100 price drop on AirPods Max 2. But we are also tracking one of the best prices to date on brand new unlocked iPhone Air models at $159 off.

As part of the Best Buy Black Friday in July sale, you’ll now find all Apple iPhone Air models at $160 off the list prices:

  • iPhone Air 256GB $840 (Reg. $999)
  • iPhone Air 512GB $1,040 (Reg. $1,199)
  • iPhone Air 1TB $1,240 (Reg. $1,400)

Best Buy has largely been the place to score the best deals on iPhone Air since release in fall 2025. Apple’s ultra-thin handset previously maxed out at $149 off in our early June mention, but all models are now $10 less than our previous mention to deliver the best deal we have tracked from a reputable source.

You will find some used and refurbished listings for less at Amazon, but when it comes to brand new unlocked models, Best Buy is where you’ll want to be.

That said, Amazon is offering slightly better prices on other current-generation Apple gear by comparison to the Best Buy Black Friday in July offerings:

  • AirTag 2 4-pack $89 (Reg. $99) – matching all-time low
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,649 (Reg. $1,799)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard $80 (Reg. $99)
  • Apple Magic Keyboard full-size with Touch ID $145 (Reg. $179)
